seo.title: Copero Game Online · Football Career Simulator
seo.description: Create a footballer, complete an eight-attribute draft, choose a club and play through contracts, transfers, national-team call-ups, trophies and career decisions.
seo.ogDescription: Build a player from eight attributes and play through an entire football career in your browser.

hero.title: Build a player. Play an entire career.
hero.body: Copero is a browser football career simulator. Choose an identity and position, build eight attributes from football legends, then decide how your career develops through clubs, contracts, events and international football.

resultCard.name: YOUR CAREER
resultCard.description: The final summary brings together your rating, attributes, clubs, statistics, trophies and career path.

howTo.title: From the first attribute to retirement
howTo.body: A career moves through clear stages while keeping one continuous game state from start to finish.

identity.title: Create your player
identity.body: Choose a surname, shirt number, preferred foot, nationality, optional family nationality and position.

draft.title: Complete 8 rounds
draft.body: Each legend contributes their best still-available attribute until PAC, SHO, PAS, DRI, DEF, PHY, SKL and WF are complete.

origin.title: Choose your starting path
origin.body: You receive three origin clubs balanced around development, exposure, minutes and difficulty.

career.title: Play the career
career.body: Simulate seasons, negotiate contracts, take transfers, respond to events, represent a national team and eventually retire.

modes.title: Classic or Purist
modes.body: Both modes feed into the same career. The difference is how much information you get during the draft.

classic.title: Classic
classic.body: Shows each legend's values and gives you up to five rerolls before you confirm an attribute.

purist.title: Purist
purist.body: Hides the values and removes rerolls, so you choose using football knowledge alone.

mechanics.title: Your decisions change the career path
mechanics.body: Copero is more than a result screen. Attributes, potential, squad role, club reputation, objectives and events combine to create different careers.

growth.title: Attributes and potential
growth.body: Each position applies different weights to the eight attributes and sets a potential ceiling for development.

clubs.title: Clubs, roles and contracts
clubs.body: Bench, rotation, starter and undisputed roles affect minutes and salary; you can also negotiate terms and move clubs.

events.title: Events and traits
events.body: Chosen traits change how often certain events appear, and decisions can improve or derail a career.

national.title: National team and trophies
national.body: A call-up can come through your main or family nationality, with separate international statistics and trophies.

career.title: The final result tells the whole career
career.body: At retirement you receive a D-to-S grade and a summary of peak OVR, potential, statistics, wealth, trophies, objectives and clubs. The result card can be copied, shared or downloaded as an image.

free.question: Does Copero run in the browser?
free.answer: Yes. The current experience is a web application and does not require a separate client installation.

save.question: Is my career saved?
save.answer: Yes. Game state is stored locally in the browser. Switching from /es/game to /en/game or /zh-cn/game keeps the same career.

classic.question: What changes between Classic and Purist?
classic.answer: Classic reveals attributes and gives five legend rerolls. Purist hides values and does not allow rerolls.

official.question: Is this an official product?
official.answer: No. copero.top is an independent project and does not claim official affiliation with Copero, clubs or players.

finalCta.title: Choose eight attributes and see how far you can go.
finalCta.body: Start a new career or continue the existing local save in the same browser.
